rule: as eval/summarize.mjs precision(): good = sells the product (yes or equivalent) and the shop exists; bad = does not sell it, or confirmed not to exist; unknown = either answer unknown

rows.name: Affinity Kitchens
rows.notes: Cabinetry and kitchen design/remodeling firm with design showrooms, not a retailer of kitchen goods; no knives or cutlery on the site. Its own showroom page lists 7848 East Redfield Road #10, Scottsdale (https://www.affinitykitchens.com/contact/scottsdale-kitchen-design-showroom).

rows.name: Jetta Bath & Kitchen
rows.notes: Domain no longer resolves (DNS failure); listings describe a bath/kitchen fixtures showroom (decorative plumbing, cabinet hardware, bathtubs), not cutlery. Conflicting status: Yelp's listing title reads 'CLOSED' (https://www.yelp.com/biz/jetta-bath-and-kitchen-scottsdale-2) while https://www.theremodelingfirmllc.com/contact still places its showroom inside Jetta at 15250 N Hayden Rd Ste 2.

rows.name: The House of Rice Store
rows.notes: URL (on an unrelated cafe domain) returns 404. Listings described an Asian grocery/housewares store with kitchen items and cutlery, but it has closed: Sphinx Date Co. announced it is moving into 3221 N Hayden Rd, 'the iconic House of Rice' space (https://sphinxdateranch.com/blogs/news/moving-news-and-preorder-2025-harvest), and Yelp marks it CLOSED.

rows.name: KoKoMo Grills & BBQ Islands & Outdoor Kitchens
rows.notes: Outdoor kitchen retailer (built-in grills, pizza ovens, cabinets, refrigeration); a site search for 'knife' returns only grills and kitchen components (https://kokomogrills.com/search?q=knife). Homepage names 1325 E Gibson Lane as its central Phoenix showroom (https://kokomogrills.com/).

rows.name: TriGreen Equipment
rows.notes: John Deere dealer at 340 9th Ave N selling mowers, tractors, compact construction equipment and STIHL/ECHO/EGO outdoor power tools (chainsaws, blowers, trimmers), none of which is a drill; the location page lists no drills (https://trigreenequipment.com/location/franklin).

rows.name: Cumberland Hardware Co
rows.notes: Long-running neighborhood hardware store at 1018 Woodland St with current hours (Yelp updated July 2026; https://local.yahoo.com/info-14932034-cumberland-hardware-nashville/), but no listing or review mentions drills or power tools. The Facebook URL returned almost no content.

rows.name: TreeHouse Foods - Naturally Fresh
rows.address: 1000 Naturally Fresh Blvd, College Park, GA 30349
rows.notes: TreeHouse is a private-label food manufacturer, not a retailer (https://treehousefoods.com/); the Naturally Fresh site is a dressings/sauces plant. Map listings still show Naturally Fresh at this address, but TreeHouse's site never mentions it and a CoStar headline reports the plant being sold, so current operation is unclear.

rows.name: ampm
rows.notes: Chain convenience store; the national homepage shows only food and drinks and says nothing about flashlights or headlamps (https://ampm.com/). A 24-hour ARCO/ampm operates at 7125 McCracken Rd per GasBuddy (https://www.gasbuddy.com/station/205206) and Yelp.

rows.name: Califa Sports Store
rows.notes: https://califasports.com/ has an expired TLS certificate, and behind it is a Network Solutions 'under construction' placeholder. Two web searches found no Califa Sports listing at 700 Edgewater Blvd or elsewhere in Foster City.

rows.name: Outdoor Supply Hardware
rows.notes: Site returns a Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches, but search-indexed product pages on the chain's own site list headlamps (e.g. NEBO Einstein https://www.outdoorsupplyhardware.com/2797444/product/Nebo-NEB-HLP-0005, Coast XPH30R, Energizer HDA32E); this is chain-wide, not Millbrae-specific stock. The Millbrae store at 900 El Camino Real has current hours (Yelp updated Sept 2026).

rows.name: Summit Bicycles
rows.notes: The bare-domain URL has an expired certificate, but the www page loads and shows the store open at 1031 California Dr. Its lighting category lists handlebar/seatpost bike lights, not headlamps; one Knog light includes a helmet mount (https://www.summitbicycles.com/product-list/accessories-1109/lighting-1130/).

rows.name: The Gearage
rows.notes: New and used outdoor gear shop at 142 Remington St with current hours (https://gearageoutdoorsports.com/). Its 79-item online sample (the site says it is not the full inventory) has no water bottles; the only bottle mention is a photo caption showing 'a Gearage water bottle'.

rows.name: Toy Store
rows.notes: The Mall of America directory lists this general toy store inside Nickelodeon Universe (Pokemon, Hot Wheels, Barbie, Schleich, Sanrio) but doesn't mention puzzles (https://mallofamerica.com/directory/toys). A mall holiday press release mentions Wicked puzzles but doesn't say which store sells them.

rows.name: Cabela's
rows.notes: Store page confirms the Hamburg store at 100 Cabela Drive; its listed departments (hunting, fishing, camping, clothing, home and gifts) include no lighting or bulbs (https://stores.cabelas.com/us/pa/hamburg/100-cabela-drive.html). The national site sells LED flashlights and lanterns and has a 'Lightbulbs' accessories category (blocked to fetch), with no evidence of household LED bulbs.

rows.name: Boba Heaven Of Elmhurst
rows.address: 573 N York St, Elmhurst, IL 60126, United States
rows.notes: Bubble tea shop: its online-ordering page is a JS app, and its menu on delivery listings is prepared drinks (boba, fruit drinks, flavored teas, coffee), with no packaged tea. Active at 573 N York St with daily hours (Yelp updated May 2026; https://www.doordash.com/store/boba-heaven-elmhurst-25987060/).

rows.name: Dreamers Gourmet - Specialty Food Manufacturer
rows.notes: Specialty food manufacturer (taco shells, edible spoons, cannoli shells) run as a division of a foodservice company; no tea and no retail storefront. Site lists 4318 River Road, Schiller Park (https://dreamersgourmet.com/).

rows.name: Milkteaful
rows.address: 3122 W North Ave, Stone Park, IL 60165
rows.notes: The Square Online catalog behind https://milkteaful.square.site/ is 50 prepared drinks (boba milk teas, iced jasmine green tea, smoothies) with no loose tea. The store location data gives 3122 W North Ave, Stone Park, with daily pickup hours.

rows.name: Garden Gourmet Market
rows.notes: Gourmet grocery at 1130 N Ashland (produce, cheese, fresh-ground coffee, wine, craft beer), active per Yelp updated Aug 2026 and DoorDash (https://www.doordash.com/en/convenience/store/garden-gourmet-market-chicago-2526442/). No source mentions tea; the Facebook URL returned almost no content.

rows.name: Austin Coffee Technician
rows.notes: Espresso machine repair service (by appointment) that also deals Rocket/La Pavoni/Rancilio machines; no pour-over gear on https://austincoffeetechnician.com/. Address conflict: its own site lists 217 Millington Lane, Buda, while Birdeye lists 2119 Frate Barker Rd #1101 (a search result suggests that is a live-work apartment building).

rows.name: Embrace The Grind BTX
rows.notes: Espresso truck; the Square Online catalog behind https://embracethegrindbtx.com/ is only coffee beans, a shirt and a sticker. Listed as an espresso truck at 824 Main St, Buda, on Yelp (updated Dec 2025) and Apple Maps.

rows.name: Kyle's Daily Grind
rows.notes: Cafe; its Square Online catalog (45 items) is drinks, pastries, whole-bean coffee, a tea box set and a T-shirt, with no brewing equipment. Site lists 607 West Center Street Unit A, Kyle (https://kylesdailygrind.com/).

rows.name: Praxis Coffee Roasters
rows.notes: Roaster cafe whose Square catalog includes some brewing gear (Baratza Encore grinder, Fellow Atmos canister, Fellow mug) but no dripper; its 'Pour Over' item is a brewed drink made with an Origami or Chemex. Site lists 10400 Menchaca Road, open daily 7a-2p (https://praxiscoffee.com/).

rows.name: Tiny House Coffee Roasters
rows.notes: Roaster whose full catalog is whole-bean coffee, cold brew concentrate and kegs, subscriptions and merch, with no drippers or brewing gear (https://tinyhousecoffeeroasters.com/collections/all). Site lists 120 Precision Drive Unit B100, Buda as a warehouse open by appointment only (https://tinyhousecoffeeroasters.com/).

rows.name: Callahan's General Store
rows.notes: General store at 501 S Hwy 183 (western wear, hardware, feed); its Home and Garden page lists Lodge cast iron, canning and kitchen gadgets but no coffee drippers or coffee makers (https://callahansgs.com/homeandgarden/).

rows.name: CoffeePeople
rows.notes: Cafe inside BookPeople serving coffee drinks and food for dine-in and takeout, with no brewing gear listed (https://bookpeople.com/cafe). Yelp lists it at 603 N Lamar Blvd, updated May 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/coffeepeople-austin-3).

rows.name: Cutco® Kitchen
rows.notes: Cutco sells knives, cutlery sets, cooking tools, tableware and outdoor knives, with no coffee brewing equipment (https://cutco.com/). The Austin store at 3201 Bee Caves Rd is listed on Yelp, updated September 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/cutco-kitchen-austin-2).

rows.name: Amherst Market
rows.notes: Site domain does not resolve (DNS not found). Directory listings show a grocery/convenience store with a deli at 259 Triangle St, licensed as Amherst Market since 2020, with no clothing (https://www.merchantcircle.com/amherst-market2-amherst-ma, https://maps.apple.com/place?place-id=IA3A1D92C11F5098D).

rows.name: Wendell Country Store
rows.notes: Country store selling milk, eggs, groceries, beer, wine, snacks and movies, with no clothing or rain gear listed; blog last posted 2011 (https://wendellcountrystore.wordpress.com/). Yelp lists it at 57 Lockes Village Rd, updated April 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/wendell-country-store-wendell).

rows.name: Hilton's Tent City
rows.notes: Outdoor gear and apparel store listing rain jackets such as the Marmot PreCip Eco Jacket and a Marmot GORE-TEX jacket, at 565 Mass Ave, Cambridge, open Mon-Sat 11-6 (https://hiltonstentcity.com/).

rows.name: AT&T Store
rows.notes: AT&T store page for 291 N York St lists phones, cases, phone chargers, headphones and wearables; no AA or rechargeable household batteries (https://att.com/stores/illinois/elmhurst/81521?wtExtndSource=stores).

rows.name: Verizon
rows.notes: Russell Cellular is a Verizon authorized retailer selling phones, tablets, cases, chargers and protection plans, not household batteries (https://russellcellular.com/). Verizon's locator lists Russell Cellular Northlake at 75 W North Ave (https://www.verizon.com/stores/details/illinois/northlake/russell-cellular-northlake-1361722/).

rows.name: BOND'S Television & Electronics
rows.notes: Site returned HTTP 403 to the fetch, while search-indexed pages show it live. Listings describe a home theater and TV sales/service business at 1010 W Lynn St, with no mention of USB-C cables (https://www.yelp.com/biz/bonds-television-and-electronics-austin-4, https://www.bbb.org/us/tx/austin/profile/home-theater-systems/bonds-television-electronics-0825-39228).

rows.name: CompuPlus
rows.address: 5555 N Lamar Blvd Ste C122, Austin, TX 78751
rows.notes: Computer and phone repair shop at 5555 N Lamar Blvd Suite C122 with posted hours; its online catalog shows used laptops, parts and a KVM switch but no USB-C cables (https://compuplus.shop/, https://www.compuplus.shop/category/all-products).

rows.name: Dollar General

Store page returned HTTP 401 to the fetch; Yelp lists the store at 241 N Grundy Quarles Hwy, updated November 2025 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/dollar-general-gainesboro).

rows.name: Kid to Kid Brentwood
rows.notes: Resale kids store at 95 Seaboard Ln with posted hours; it sells used toys, puzzles and books, but inventory varies and no train sets are listed (https://kidtokid.com/brentwood).

rows.name: The Museum Store
rows.address: 222 Rep. John Lewis Way S, Nashville, TN 37203
rows.notes: Country Music Hall of Fame shop at 222 Rep. John Lewis Way S, open daily; its kids section and a search for "train" return music books, records, apparel and plush, with no toy trains (https://shop.countrymusichalloffame.org/search?q=train).

rows.name: Wildhorse Gift Shop
rows.notes: Wildhorse Saloon at 120 2nd Ave N closed in January 2024 and the building is being reopened as Category 10 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildhorse_Saloon). The URL redirects to shop.opry.com, whose search for "train" shows no toy trains (https://shop.opry.com/search?q=train).

rows.name: Designer Fabrics (by appt only) Hunter Douglas Dealer

rows.name: Allyn's Fabric and Bridal

rows.name: Ibraheems Rugs

rows.name: Treelotta: Fabric + Craft Studio
rows.notes: Fabric and craft store selling wool and wool felt by the yard plus yarn, but no finished blankets (https://treelotta.com/). Yelp lists it at 3370 S Broadway, updated June 2026 (https://www.yelp.com/biz/treelotta-fabric-craft-studio-englewood).
